prompt:

Input1: current apartment360 panorama is GEOMETRY/ADJACENCY evidence ONLY, NOT output projection. Keep the existing floor plan, original doors/windows and all previously approved functional layouts. DO NOT output360/equirectangular/fisheye, a collage, curved walls, a board of samples, an exterior or a close-up that loses the room. Correct straight verticals and a real28-32mm architectural lens, plausible small-apartment proportions. Every visible edge, reveal, textile seam and fixture must look built, not generic CGI: fine open wood grain at realistic scale, tiny eased edge, satin non-plastic metal, actual separate fabric weave, coherent tiled joints, properly supported shelves, meaningful surface contact shadows. Natural soft NEUTRAL daylight plus just a few local warm task pools; readable white balance, no overall yellow/orange haze, HDR halos or artificial blur. No people, text, visible brand logos, watermarks or cloned botanical art everywhere. This is an original home design informed by published general design principles, not a reproduction of a designer's named project. THE USER EXPLICITLY WANTS INTENTIONAL OBJECT PLACEMENT AND SMALL LIVED-IN DECORATIONS: do not make an empty showroom. Group useful small personal items around actual daily activities, harmonize material/colour/height and leave working surfaces free. Don't randomly scatter repetitive props.

LEARNED DESIGN PRIORITIES: Keep the reference home's wood-edge WHITE coffee table, green/oatmeal TICKING STRIPE sofa/bedding and window plant grouping. Make built-ins precise with thin real wood edge-banding, quiet reveals, aligned shelf brackets, small rounded corners and a recessed timber toe kick. Restrained subtle sage niche or cabinet face, a small handmade ceramic backsplash detail, one paper/opal task lamp. Replace crowded generic plant/flower/poster arrangements with three intentional heights at existing window. White surface stays matte and clean, no fake yellow sunwash, thick jungle plants on every shelf or huge rope patterns.
EXACT LAYOUT: Original narrow1.65x3.70m bathroom: north shower then middle toilet then basin and standard60cm front-load washer at lower end, washer and basin share1.48m counter, .94m aisle. Original small privacy window and door retained; no bathtub, double sink, new window or extra width.
VISIBLE IMPROVEMENTS: Large quiet matte stone/ceramic tile with a coherent thin grout grid instead of noisy beige swirls, counter-to-wall slim neat seal, aligned cabinet and appliance front, shallow closed towel storage, natural wood-look moisture-resistant cabinet faces, clean shower glass edge/seal, credible floor drain and taps, small opal mirror lights that illuminate a face, reachable towel hook. No wooden wet-shower ceiling, LED glow outlining everything or plants beside electrical switches.
LIVED-IN STYLING: LIVED-IN STYLING: one compact wash tray holding soap dispenser and two functional toothbrush cups near basin, folded hand towel on reachable hook and one clean bath towel grouped on a small rail; closed towel cabinet plus ONE low linen basket outside wet walking route. Shower niche holds two restrained unbranded bath bottles, no forest of cosmetics. Keep counter around washer access clear. A small personal ceramic dish is enough; no unrelated plants around electrics, decorative vases or spa-hotel pile of rolled towels.
